findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_link · Private data: get_upload_link, scan_document, word_to_pdf, convert_vietnamese_font · Public sink: get_upload_link, expand_image, convert_vietnamese_font · Destructive: get_upload_link, remove_background, colorize_photo, sharpen_image, expand_image, scan_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_link · Private data: get_upload_link, scan_document, word_to_pdf, convert_vietnamese_font · Public sink: get_upload_link, expand_image, convert_vietnamese_font · Destructive: get_upload_link, remove_background, colorize_photo, sharpen_image, expand_image, scan_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
